findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), reducing cryptographic hygiene, and no explicit key policy is defined, meaning AWS applies the default key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM. This can allow any IAM principal with appropriate IAM permissions to use or manage the key, weakening access control on sensitive audit trail encryption keys.
